Zhou (S1) lowers his chopsticks and places the second whole shrimp down onto Lin Wan's small dish, saying: <d>[Chinese]这盘就你没动。减肥啊？</d> Lin Wan (S2) then picks up the shrimp from her small dish with her own chopsticks, reaches forward to the center of the table, and sets it down onto the shared communal plate — clearly returning it — and says quietly: <d>[Chinese]懒得剥。</d> Zhou (S1) replies: <d>[Chinese]喜欢吃还懒。</d> Lin Wan withdraws her chopsticks and lets them rest at the edge of her now-empty small dish, her gaze lowering. unit-03.integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, warm tungsten golden light with light film grain, a company dinner four years ago; gentle handheld breathing camera. The shot opens exactly on the same crisp shrimp-shell crack carried over from the previous scene — a hard sound-bridge cut from the present into four years ago. Matching Picture 1, Chen Yu — short black hair, blue crew-neck top, steady, head down — cracks and peels a whole poached shrimp, a small pile of shells already before him, while beside him Lin Wan's small bowl holds a few peeled shrimp. Chen Yu keeps peeling continuously; the pile of shells visibly grows taller and more peeled shrimp accumulate in Lin Wan's bowl. The camera breathes and eases from the close view of his hands out to a two-person relationship framing (one continuous take, no hard cut). Lin Wan — same face, four years younger, warmer, secure in being adored — lifts a freshly peeled shrimp up to her eyes as if inspecting how clean it is, suppressing a smile, and says: <d>[Chinese]你能不能快点？我这边都断供了。</d> Chen Yu, without looking up, keeps peeling and answers in a steady low voice: <d>[Chinese]着什么急。</d> The ending matches Picture 2: a distinctly taller pile of shells, Lin Wan's bowl noticeably fuller with peeled shrimp, and Lin Wan holding up the peeled shrimp with a suppressed smile.
unit-03.overall_soundscape: Warm, full dinner-party ambience with overlapping laughter and chatter; the incoming crisp shrimp-shell crack lands right at the very start as the sound bridge, then the steady small sounds of shells being cracked, peeled and dropped onto the growing pile.
